issue.title: Bob Mac Capture renders bob capture link_guard results for Blocked link targets

task_type_fields.proposal: In bob-mac-capture, render the capture result's additive link_guard object ({reasons[], promoted[], detail}) for @r+id!, @r:id, ensure-next and close-link gestures, and for new tasks captured unlinked into a Blocked state. Show 'Not linked: <reasons> · promoted <ids>' instead of a link confirmation. The bob-side output must stop claiming a link in existing fields; that part is tracked as remaining bob-cli-6u landing work.
task_type_fields.why_out_of_scope: Swift change in the linked bob-mac-capture repo, outside bob-cli-6u's plan. The plan's cli-capture-links step 6 says to record a Bob Mac Capture follow-up when capture output semantics change.

issue.creation_reason: bob-cli-6u.9 added link_guard (not_linked reasons and promoted prerequisites) to capture JSON for link gestures that hit a Blocked target; Bob Mac Capture does not render it yet.

payload.entry: CLI output contract from bob-cli-6u.18.3: inspect kind, toggle_direction, block_link, day_file, pomodoro_link_action, and link_guard. A consumed Pomodoro-link gesture emits kind="link_guard" and its link_guard result, omitting day_file, block_link, creates_pomodoro, and pomodoro_link_action. Consumed task-toggle/ensure-next output omits toggle_direction and block_link; toggle_behavior can remain for ensure-next, and day_file appears only when existing links were removed. Unknown kind should render without a link-success claim.
